headline: Oil Rises To 101.19 From 100.05 As The Gain Widens To 1.73 Percent
narrative: Oil rose to 101.19, a 1.73 percent gain, from 100.05 and a 0.58 percent gain. Silver fell to 53.9, a 1.57 percent loss, from 54.01 and a 1.37 percent loss, while gold rose to 4,037.3 and the daily loss narrowed to 0.57 percent from 0.6 percent at 4,036.0. The oil pipe is the cash price of crude, so the higher print means crude cash value rose, and the metals pipe is the cash price of silver and gold, so the wider silver loss means that cash value fell while the gold loss narrowed.
author: jordan
